description: Call this when your human describes the look, feel or voice with taste words ('clean', 'modern', 'premium', 'playful', 'make it pop', 'friendly', 'professional', 'sounds robotic') or feeling words ('exciting', 'amazing', 'wow', 'make people excited'). Returns the concrete decisions those words usually mean. Say your translation back to the human in one line BEFORE building or writing, so a wrong reading costs nothing.

words.description: The human's words, as they wrote them, e.g. 'clean and modern' or 'make it more friendly'

name: ihumane_translate_taste
title: Translate taste words into decisions
